title: Network Anomaly Detection System (Research)
description: Unsupervised intrusion detection framework using KMeans, DBSCAN and GMM, with sub-100 ms detection latency.
moreDetails: PCA reduces the NSL-KDD features from 41 to 10 while retaining 95% of the variance. Includes a real-time Android app with radar and bar chart visualizations. Paper: Accuracy Is Not the Bottleneck (preprint).

title: Stress-Testing CNNs: ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10
description: ResNet-18 trained from scratch on CIFAR-10, stress-tested through high-confidence failure analysis and explainability, then improved with one controlled change: label smoothing (93.62% → 94.35%).
moreDetails: Mined wrong predictions made with over 85% confidence and found a shared pattern: every one was predicted as "dog", pointing to an overconfident class template. Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++ and saliency maps were implemented from scratch to explain each failure. Adding label smoothing (ε = 0.1), with architecture, optimizer and schedule unchanged, raised test accuracy by 0.73% and dog-class accuracy by 2.3%. Team project with Anik De and Juhi Chaudhary (IIT Jodhpur).

title: SFLCDApp: Federated Crop Disease Detection
description: Simulated federated learning for crop disease detection, using lightweight CNN models that run on Android devices.
moreDetails: Published at CML-2026. Read the paper.

title: Attendance Management System
description: Face recognition-based attendance system using OpenCV and LBPH, integrated with MySQL for classroom attendance tracking.
moreDetails: Published as Efficient Face Recognition-Based Attendance System with Adaptive Lighting and Pose Normalization (Springer).

title: Mango Blossom Disease Detection
description: CNN models (VGG16, ResNet50) that classify mango blossom diseases from 5,000 images, deployed as an Android app for real-time diagnosis by farmers.

title: College Management App
description: Android app for college resource management with notifications, eBooks and lecture integration, built on Firebase and Material UI.

title: Online Examination App
description: Android app for conducting online exams, with secure authentication, question management and result tracking on Firebase.
